decisions.reason: The low-pile carpet stays close to the core offer and kept its own page in 2024, which suggests results that meet aspiration in a growing industry, and slack lets the firm carry it.
The premium hand-knotted wool silk carpet fits the firm's craftsmanship positioning and remains prominently presented, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The corner bench moved from its own page to a mention, a weaker signal, but it is still actively promoted as new, so management likely keeps it while its results are still uncertain.
The carpet line extension is low cost to maintain and kept its own page, but the firm already pruned a similar carpet (C), so a small risk of further pruning remains.
The swivel shell chair is close to the core seating offer and kept its own page, which indicates satisfactory performance.
